The national CDC count stands at 1,893 confirmed cases as of May 14 — up 51 from May 7 — confirming the upward trajectory. Washington State's 40+ cases across 8 counties with Kittitas County in active outbreak status remain operative. The school vaccination window is approximately 9 days — one day inside what was yesterday the 'final double-digit interval.' The school-year end closes the school-based mass immunization channel entirely; community and outpatient settings cannot replicate the institutional reach or speed. Wednesday May 20 is the penultimate full business week of the school year — emergency bulletins, county escalation alerts, and school-administrator communications issued this week carry the maximum school-setting leverage of the remaining intervention horizon. The most consequential near-term trigger is a second Oregon hospitalization or new county outbreak declaration during this 9-day window. Second: Portland-metro gasoline remains above $5.00/gallon — the Iran countdown's contingent pump-relief scenario requires deal confirmation, Hormuz reopening framework, and implementation, measured in weeks at minimum. The forward curve reflects no imminent Hormuz reopening. Third: the broader Iran war economic cascade continues to compound PNW household and municipal constraints. Portland's $172 million city budget shortfall; 30-year Treasury at 5.121% raising Portland and OR/WA municipal borrowing costs; supply-shock energy inflation persisting through the season. The IEA's Q2 2026 oil demand contraction projection (approximately 1.5 million barrels per day — sharpest since COVID) reflects the economic demand destruction the Hormuz closure has induced globally, with PNW export-dependent sectors (agriculture, timber, technology) disproportionately exposed to the global demand compression.

analyst_summary: Wednesday May 20, 2026 morning — Hormuz Day 82, Naval Blockade Day 39, Project Freedom Pause Day 15, WPA Day 21 Past Statutory Deadline, Warsh Day 6. Vibe 3 — direction of travel downward. The overnight record is defined by what did not happen: no Iranian official responded to the Gulf allies' 'very close to a deal' characterization that Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE delivered to Trump on May 18 to hold a 'very major attack' planned for that day. The confirmation vacuum now extends 36+ hours. Day 2 of Trump's 2-3 day countdown opened at sunrise with the mathematical deadline closing Thursday-Friday, May 21-22. The structural impediments are unchanged — Iran's 5-year enrichment moratorium vs. the US 20-year demand; the congressional zero-enrichment constraint (52 senators, 177 House members) non-negotiable on the US side; MOU unrevived; no Xi-Iran commitment from Beijing; parliament 'wish list' characterization unretracted. Overnight reporting from the Times of Israel and early NYT signals are surfacing that US and Israeli military planners are beginning to articulate active war renewal preparation timelines — 'as soon as next week' — with Israel readying to strike Iranian nuclear facilities if talks fail. These signals are not yet fully corroborated at this morning's filing; they represent the opening note of what Wednesday's reporting will amplify. If corroborated through the session, the vibe lands at 2 by evening. The deal track's sole active positive: the Gulf allies' May 19 intervention — Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE simultaneously on-record vouching for deal proximity — remains the highest-quality regional pressure signal of the conflict cycle. Vibe 3 reflects this genuine dual-track reality; it does not hold if the morning's nascent military planning signals reach full corroboration without Iranian engagement. Warsh enters Day 6 without a statement; 10-year at 4.66% open, 30-year at 5.121%; Cleveland Fed nowcast adverse; June FOMC 28 days out; CNN Business deliberate-silence interpretive framing compounds the anchor problem. DOE $1.9B grid application deadline is today — May 20's most significant federal infrastructure action. Oregon fire season Day 13, 12 days to east Cascades onset, federal prepositioning window 12 days and closing. Pine Mountain Fire 85% contained. OHA measles 28 days stale; school window 9 days — penultimate full business week of the school year. CISA Day 17 clean streak, longest of post-summit window; IRGC cyber window fully open; Wednesday is the highest-priority monitoring day of the post-summit cycle. Israel-Lebanon ceasefire Day 5 of 45-day extension holding. Vibe 3.
watch_items: Iranian official response — any channel: Wednesday's primary watch item; every hour without a response from Araghchi, Pezeshkian, Khamenei, or Iranian state media is a countdown unit consumed; an Iranian confirmation would be the most significant positive signal since the Axios MOU scoop; Iranian rejection or silence through Wednesday close elevates Thursday-Friday resumption probability sharply

Times of Israel / NYT war renewal corroboration: overnight signals of 'as soon as next week' US-Israel war renewal preparation have not reached full multi-outlet corroboration at this morning's filing; watch for additional US official, regional official, or US intelligence community confirmation through the Wednesday session — full corroboration is the trigger for Vibe 2 by evening

Witkoff / Rubio deal-track statement: Gulf sovereigns publicly vouched for deal proximity on May 19; no US negotiator has elaborated; a Witkoff or Rubio statement on deal terms or countdown status would be the primary US diplomatic signal of the day

Trump Truth Social — countdown update or expiry: Trump's primary public channel; any update on countdown status, deal terms, military readiness posture, or countdown extension or expiry is the dominant US political signal for markets and military planning

Warsh Day 6 — statement or Fed calendar update: the most consequential delayed Fed communication of the current cycle; Wednesday coincides with the most critical 24 hours of the Iran countdown; any Warsh statement on the economic environment, inflation, or monetary policy is the primary domestic economic catalyst; the CNN Business deliberate-silence interpretive frame makes any statement — or confirmed absence — an anchor signal

CENTCOM carrier positioning: any order to reposition carrier strike group assets, resume active patrol posture, or lift the Project Freedom Pause is the primary military signal; watch for White House 48-hr congressional notification which would be the first required procedural step before military resumption

DOE $1.9B grid funding deadline: applications close today (May 20); watch for DOE official announcement or summary of submitted applications — confirms whether the federal grid investment posture is intact or whether applicant confidence has been affected by Hormuz-driven energy cost uncertainty

Oregon fire season — 12-day federal prepositioning window: one-way door; watch for NWS Red Flag Warning activity in inland OR/WA, any Forest Service response to the May 7 delegation letter, any new BLM restriction escalation, or any ODF emergency declaration; each day without federal action on the Region 6 gap is irreversible

OHA measles — 28-day staleness, school window 9 days: penultimate full business week of school year; watch for OHA emergency bulletin, updated case count, new county outbreak declaration, or second Oregon hospitalization; 9 days is the final meaningful school-based intervention window

CISA / FBI / IC3 — highest-priority monitoring day of post-summit cycle: countdown Day 2; deal collapse at Thursday-Friday expiry spikes IRGC retaliation probability sharply; any new CISA advisory, FBI/IC3 flash, or OT/ICS incident on Wednesday carries maximum significance in the countdown context
